svg.text: Share of each period's firms that can be placed
1945–1962 is the outlier: 1,486 of its firms are filed
under the transversal Empire rubric with no country at
all. That panel is a thinner sample, not a thinner

g.text: no dated tie in the period

Five panels, one layout: a firm holds the same pixel in all five, so a difference between panels is a difference in the data. Paris's share of the drawable ties falls from 63.4% to 26.1%. Read the 1945–1962 panel with care: only 36.1% of its firms can be
placed, against 84–87% in every other period, because 1,486 of them are filed under the transversal *Empire* rubric with no country at all. See figure 58.
